doc: A dialog that asks before something that cannot be undone, runs it, and stays open with the error when it fails. While the action runs, nothing closes the dialog.

state.phase: idle | confirming | working | failed: idle is closed; the others show the dialog
state.error: string | null: the failure shown in the dialog
state.attempt: int: the number of the latest run; only its result counts

run.attempt: int: start the action, and report its result with this number

rules: The dialog is closed (idle) until request opens it (confirming). request while it is open does nothing.
confirm while confirming starts the action: working, a new attempt number, and run{attempt}.
While working, the confirm button is busy: a second confirm does nothing.
While working, nothing closes the dialog: cancel by the button, Escape or the scrim does nothing.
cancel while confirming or failed closes the dialog (idle) and clears the error. Escape and a press on the scrim are both a cancel.
succeeded for the current attempt closes the dialog (idle) and emits done.
failed for the current attempt keeps the dialog open, in failed, showing the error message.
confirm while failed retries: working, the error cleared, a new attempt number and run{attempt}.
A result for any other attempt, or one that arrives when nothing is working, does nothing.

scenarios.name: failure keeps the dialog open and retry succeeds
